title: SkillTrustRecord
description: Trust record produced by the Skill Trust Scoring Engine (v3.2.0 S4). Captures the computed 0-100 score, tier assignment, and the quality signals that contributed to the score.

skillName.description: Canonical skill name (kebab-case, matches directory name under .claude/skills/).

source.description: Provenance category of the skill. 'builtin' always resolves to tier=builtin and score=100.

score.description: Computed 0-100 trust score. Builtin skills are always 100.

tier.description: Trust tier derived from score. builtin=100, verified=80-99, community=50-79, experimental=0-49.

signals.description: Raw quality signals used as scorer inputs.

hasTests.description: True if at least one test file exists for this skill (tests/skills/<name>*.test.cjs).

testCount.description: Number of test cases found. Informational only — not used in score computation.

ageDays.description: Age of the skill in days since first commit or install.

downloadCount.description: Total download count from the marketplace registry. 0 for locally-sourced skills.

reviewRating.description: Community peer review rating (0.0–5.0). 0 means unrated.

provenanceSha.description: HMAC-SHA256 provenance hash for bundle verification (v2.2.0+ requirement). Null if not signed.

breakdown.description: Per-component points that sum to the final score (before builtin override).

peerReviewRating.description: Points from peer review rating (0–30, proportional).

computedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this trust record was computed.

tierThresholds.description: Tier threshold configuration active at computation time (may be overridden via env vars).

verified.description: Minimum score for verified tier (default 80, env: TRUST_TIER_VERIFIED_MIN).

community.description: Minimum score for community tier (default 50, env: TRUST_TIER_COMMUNITY_MIN).
